seo_home_title: Flower delivery in Kyiv by Bloomify
seo_home_p1: Bloomify is an online flower shop in Kyiv where you can buy a bouquet with delivery from 2 hours. Our florists hand-craft signature arrangements every day from fresh roses, peonies, tulips, and seasonal flowers, so the bouquet arrives exactly as you saw it in the photo.
seo_home_p2: Order flowers online for any occasion: a birthday, an anniversary, a date, or simply to delight your mom, girlfriend, or colleague. Paying by card, Apple Pay, or Google Pay takes a minute, and a courier delivers the bouquet at a convenient time.
seo_home_p3: If you love having fresh flowers at home or in the office all the time, try our flower subscription — recurring delivery of new seasonal arrangements without placing an order each time.
seo_catalog_title: Buy a bouquet in Kyiv with delivery
seo_catalog_p1: The Bloomify catalog features bouquets of roses, peonies, tulips, and seasonal flowers — from minimalist mono-bouquets to large signature arrangements. Use tag filters and price sorting to quickly find your bouquet.
seo_catalog_p2: Choose flowers for a birthday, wedding, anniversary, or graduation. Every arrangement is hand-assembled on the day of delivery, so the flowers stay fresh for over a week.
seo_catalog_p3: Ordering takes a couple of minutes online: secure payment by card, Apple Pay, or Google Pay, and delivery across Kyiv from 2 hours.
